project_overview.project_summary: This software / digital product project centers on New SaaS Website Landing Page Design. The initial brief says: We need a design for a new B2B SaaS website landing page. We have a logo and brand guide but now need to develop a landing page plus a look-and-feel for follow-on web pages and an associated web UI/UX. The work sits mainly in Web design and development, Graphic and editorial design, Web, Mobile & Software Dev. Stable project themes include authentication and access, administration and reporting, analytics and reporting, outbound communication, responsive or multi-platform presentation, ai-assisted workflow, web content and page delivery. The available evidence includes 101 conversation messages, 4 deliverable files, which together document the brief, collaboration, review cycle, and delivered work. The recoverable artifacts span .png formats; their contents were used only where they supplied stable domain, production, architecture, or handoff information. For engineering onboarding, the key task is to understand the product workflows, component boundaries, integrations, data responsibilities, and the evidence level behind each implementation claim before changing code. No inspectable software repository was identified, so technical details are limited to what the brief, conversation, and artifacts explicitly establish.
